title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 24355 Creekside Road in Santa Clarita, California, as the "William L. Reynolds Post Office Building".
official_summary: This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 24355 Creekside Road in Santa Clarita, California, as the William L. Reynolds Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A law renames a Santa Clarita, California post office building after William L. Reynolds.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 24355 Creekside Road in Santa Clarita, California, the William L. Reynolds Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on May 7, 2024, and the new name applies from that date.
